zero rows are unmodified SA background

own_data_diagnostics.spectral_feature_definition: HF diagnostic sums frequency indices18..24, nominal1995.3..7943.3Hz; it is not the strict >=2000Hz threshold of the q0 anchor.

source_independence_scope.conclusion: Recorded source-group/time purge is not a station/instrument-domain holdout and does not make generator families independent.

frozen_prior_only_diagnostic.interpretation: q0 is not an oracle or a validated separator; it is a poor counterfactual nuisance feature on this dataset. The CNN can learn a correction inside the same simulator without establishing generalization.

causal_hypotheses_not_confirmed: Foreign whole-recording ambient/instrument spectra may make addition-vs-no-addition easier than the intended vessel task.
Identical warp/fade/EQ and target-prior mechanisms across TRAIN/INNER may reward generator shortcuts.
Shared site/instrument families and a TRAIN-background manifold may fail under changes outside that family.
not_established: Which hypothesis caused how much of the reported RMSE difference
The actual hidden generator/label prior or Test spectrum
That stronger postprocessing or an additional model would solve the failure
That direct reference leakage or query q/y leakage explains this submission
selection_bias: Epoch selection/full INNER reuse and calibration meta-selection are real optimism sources, but no experiment here identifies them as the full explanation of the cross-population ~0.257 RMSE difference. Calibrator crossed diagnostics rejected offset/affine; identity was submitted.
next_step: Predeclared CPU physical robustness stress of fixed epoch19, no fit, is separate; it is not a reconstruction of the hidden generator.
